[Buttons]
' The command pad, four keys across and four down, spelled by the icon each key carries.
' A dash is a blank key. Rows group by domain: elements, routes, train reporting, areas.
Main:
point-straight, point-diverging, signal-stop, signal-go
route-train-set, route-train-cancel, route-shunting-set, route-shunting-release
train-approved, train-advance, -, -
area-lock, area-release, -, buttons-alternate
' Everything that is not needed while trains are running. Counterparts keep the position of
' the main button they answer to, so nothing has to be hunted for; eleven keys are free.
Alternate:
point-lock, point-unlock, signal-lock-stop, signal-unlock-stop
-, -, -, -
-, -, -, -
-, -, -, buttons-main
